metadata.command_line: /tmp/repo/experiments/eval_rs_uep.py --checkpoint /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/robust_channel/adjsccq_erasure_robust.pth --oracle_ranking_file /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/robust_channel/oracle_ranking.json --data_dir ./data --split test --importance oracle,energy --schemes three_tier_25_25_50,three_tier_25_50_25,two_tier_25_75,two_tier_50_50 --seeds 0,1,2,3,4 --include_no_rs --workers 4 --device cpu --output_dir results/phase2/robust_channel/test_sweep --name test_sweep --wandb --wandb_project rs-uep-jscc --wandb_name kaggle-eval-robust_channel

evaluation.side_info_rule: 0 B for uniform/no_rs, one byte per channel for sorted methods
evaluation.mask_protocol: one master mask per (batch, seed, rate) shared by all methods; smaller schemes use its first columns

insights: Based on 5 channel seed(s); 10000 images per seed. All gains below are paired per seed against the baseline (same packet losses), so they carry no luck-of-the-draw advantage.
Break-even: the best protected method overtakes `uniform` from about erasure_rate = 0.32.

Low-loss penalty: even the best method is 0.73 dB below `uniform` at erasure_rate = 0.3 (three_tier_25_50_25@energy). This is the block-length effect of a single large RS block, which tiered coding gives up.
Peak gain: +2.51 dB at erasure_rate = 0.45 by three_tier_25_25_50@energy (95% CI ±0.03, significant).
Importance sources ranked by their best scheme's mean gain over erasure_rate >= 0.35: energy +1.98 dB, oracle +1.05 dB.
Share of the reference ranking's gain captured: energy 188%. A share above 100% means that source allocated protection better than the reference.
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.4: 5th-percentile PSNR 20.13 dB (three_tier_25_50_25@energy) vs 18.19 dB (uniform).
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.5: 5th-percentile PSNR 17.50 dB (three_tier_25_25_50@energy) vs 16.97 dB (uniform).
Seed sensitivity: std across channel seeds stays below 0.3 dB everywhere.
`uniform` shows its steepest fall (-3.21 dB) between erasure_rate = 0.3 and 0.35 -- its cliff.
